name: Melody Maurer
bio: Entered the CFC world around 2013 through her friendship with Liana Sinclair. Lived with the Sinclair family for a period around 2014. Was in Catherine's bridal party in 2017. Close friendship with JD developed around 2018. Highly extroverted and widely traveled. As of 2025 pursuing a master's degree in social work. Her younger sister Mercy is best friends with Ellie. Her childhood best friend is Andrew Matott.
